checks.detail: all prompts in their original chapter/section

checks.check: required fields (purpose, prompt text, output, verify)
prompt title + text unchanged vs original

prompts.title: Skill-to-service brainstorm
prompts.purpose: अपनी skills से realistic service ideas निकालना।
prompts.body: Act as a practical small-business consultant in India. My skills: [list with honest level 1-5]. Time per day: [hours]. Budget: [₹]. City: [city]. People I can reach easily: [list]. Suggest 5 focused service ideas. For each give: exact buyer, problem solved, what I would deliver, the riskiest assumption, and one way to test it in 7 days without spending money. Do not invent market statistics or income figures. If you are unsure, say so.
prompts.output: 5 ideas with a test for each.
prompts.verify: हर idea के buyer के 5 real नाम खुद ढूँढकर देखिए। न मिलें तो idea कमज़ोर है।

prompts.title: Devil's advocate review
prompts.purpose: अपने favourite idea की कमज़ोरियाँ पकड़ना।
prompts.body: I am planning this service: [business statement]. Act as a sceptical investor who wants me to succeed. List the 7 strongest reasons this may fail in my market, ranked by risk. For each, give one cheap test I can run this week. Do not cite statistics unless you provide a verifiable source, and mark assumptions clearly.
prompts.output: Ranked risk list with cheap tests.
prompts.verify: Top 3 risks को real prospects से बातचीत में test कीजिए।

prompts.title: Plain-language explainer
prompts.purpose: किसी भी नए topic को आसान भाषा में समझना।
prompts.body: Explain [topic] to a beginner running a small service business in India. Use simple Hinglish, one everyday example, and a short list of 5 terms with meanings. At the end, list what I should verify from an official source because it may have changed.
prompts.verify: Verification list का हर item official site पर देखिए।

prompts.title: Source finder
prompts.purpose: AI से answer की जगह sources की दिशा लेना।
prompts.body: I need to verify this claim: "[claim]". List the types of primary sources that would confirm or refute it, the official organisation most likely to publish each, and the exact search terms I should use. Do not assert whether the claim is true unless you can name a specific source.
prompts.example: किसी platform की fee का दावा जाँचना।
prompts.verify: सुझाए गए URL खुद खोलिए; AI का बताया link बन भी सकता है।

prompts.title: Claim extractor
prompts.purpose: किसी draft के सारे checkable facts निकालना।
prompts.body: Extract every checkable factual claim from the text below into a table with columns: Claim, Type (number/date/law/name/quote/link), Risk if wrong (high/medium/low), Where to verify. Do not rewrite the text. Text: [paste]
prompts.verify: High-risk items पहले खुद check कीजिए।

prompts.title: Brief builder
prompts.purpose: आधी-अधूरी सोच से साफ़ brief बनाना।
prompts.body: Interview me one question at a time to build a brief for [task]. Ask about goal, audience, constraints, examples, success criteria, and deadline. After my last answer, write a one-page brief and list what is still unclear.
prompts.example: Client के website copy काम से पहले।
prompts.verify: Brief client को भेजकर "क्या यह सही है?" पूछिए।

prompts.title: Tone rewrite
prompts.body: Rewrite the message below so it is polite, direct and human, for a small business owner in India. Keep all facts the same, keep it under [n] words, and avoid hype words. Give 2 versions: simple English and Roman Hinglish. Message: [paste]
prompts.verify: Facts, dates और numbers original से मिलाइए।

prompts.title: Simplifier
prompts.body: Explain this technical point to a non-technical business owner in under 90 words, using one analogy and no jargon. Then tell me which detail you left out and whether that omission could mislead them. Point: [paste]
prompts.verify: किसी non-technical व्यक्ति को पढ़ाकर देखिए।

prompts.title: Editor pass
prompts.purpose: Draft को generic AI language से बचाना।
prompts.body: Edit the draft below as a strict human copy editor. Remove filler, cliches, repeated ideas and overclaims. Do not add new facts. Return the edited text, then a table of the changes that altered meaning, if any. Draft: [paste]
prompts.verify: Meaning-changing edits ध्यान से देखिए।

prompts.title: Problem statement
prompts.purpose: Service को customer problem की भाषा में लिखना।
prompts.body: My service: [service]. Buyer: [buyer]. Write 5 problem statements in the buyer's own words, as they might say them to a friend. Then mark which are assumptions I need to confirm in interviews.
prompts.verify: Real interview में इन lines को test कीजिए।

prompts.title: Scope limiter
prompts.body: For this service package: [package], list what is included, what is excluded, what the client must provide, and 5 likely "small requests" that are actually extra work. Write a friendly one-line response to each.
prompts.verify: अपनी actual capacity से मिलाइए।

prompts.title: Interview guide
prompts.purpose: Customer conversation के लिए अच्छे सवाल बनाना।
prompts.body: Create a 15-minute customer interview guide for [buyer] about [problem]. Questions must be about past behaviour and not hypothetical opinions. Include 8 questions, 3 follow-ups, and tell me what answers would count as a real buying signal.
prompts.example: Clinic owner से website पर बातचीत।
prompts.verify: Questions में अपना product pitch न हो, यह देखिए।

prompts.title: Interview synthesis
prompts.body: Below are my notes from [n] customer interviews. Identify repeated problems, exact phrases worth reusing, contradictions, and signals of willingness to pay. Quote only from my notes; do not infer anything not written. Notes: [anonymised notes]
prompts.verify: हर quote original notes में ढूँढिए।

prompts.title: Profile rewrite
prompts.purpose: LinkedIn या Instagram bio को clear बनाना।
prompts.body: Rewrite my profile for [platform]. Who I help: [buyer]. Result: [result]. Real proof available: [proof]. Give 3 headlines and a short bio. Do not imply clients, awards or experience that I have not listed.
prompts.verify: हर claim सच है, यह खुद confirm कीजिए।

prompts.title: Content repurposer
prompts.body: Turn this one insight into a LinkedIn post, a 30-second Reel script, an Instagram carousel outline and a WhatsApp status line. Keep the same core point and avoid exaggeration. Insight: [insight]
prompts.example: "Website में phone number ऊपर क्यों रखें"।
prompts.verify: Platform के हिसाब से length और tone देखिए।

prompts.title: Personalisation helper
prompts.purpose: Public जानकारी से एक सच्चा observation बनाना।
prompts.body: Here is what I noticed on this business's public page: [notes]. Write 3 possible opening lines for a message that mention one specific observation and are not flattering or fake. Under 25 words each. Do not guess facts that I did not provide.
prompts.example: Clinic की website mobile पर slow लगना।
prompts.verify: Observation खुद फिर check कीजिए।

prompts.title: Reply analyser
prompts.purpose: Prospect के reply का सही अगला कदम।
prompts.body: A prospect replied: "[reply]". My offer: [offer]. Interpret what this may mean, list 2 possible intents, and draft a short, respectful reply for each. If the message means they are not interested, the reply should end contact.
prompts.verify: दबाव वाली line हटाइए।

prompts.title: Call role-play
prompts.body: Role-play as [buyer type], a busy and slightly sceptical business owner. I will practise a discovery call for [service]. Ask realistic questions and raise realistic objections. Reply one turn at a time. When I type "feedback", score my questions and tell me where I talked too much.
prompts.example: पहली real call से पहले 2 rounds।
prompts.verify: Real call के बाद script update कीजिए।

prompts.title: Proposal first draft
prompts.body: Using these call notes: [notes], write a one-page proposal with: Understanding of problem, Proposed solution, Deliverables, Timeline, Price [price], Payment terms [terms], Assumptions, Out of scope, Next step. Use only information from my notes, and list gaps as questions rather than inventing details.
prompts.verify: Dates, price और scope खुद match कीजिए।

prompts.title: Project plan
prompts.body: Break this project into milestones with owner (me or client), effort estimate, dependency, and risk: [scope]. Deadline: [date]. Available hours per week: [hours]. Flag if the deadline is unrealistic. Output as a table.
prompts.verify: Estimates में 30% buffer जोड़िए (Chapter 6)।

prompts.title: QA checklist maker
prompts.body: Create a final quality checklist for delivering [deliverable] to [client type]. Group items by content, function, brand, legal and handover. Mark items that a human must check manually. Keep it practical, maximum 25 items.
prompts.verify: एक item actual project पर test कीजिए।

prompts.title: Difficult message
prompts.purpose: Delay या गलती की ईमानदार सूचना।
prompts.body: Draft a message to a client about: [situation]. Own what is mine, state the new date, what I am doing to prevent it from recurring, and what I need from them. Keep it calm, without excuses or over-apologising, under 100 words.
prompts.verify: नई date वही लिखिए जो आप पूरी कर सकें।

prompts.title: Formula helper
prompts.body: In Google Sheets, column A has [data], column B has [data]. I want [result]. Write the formula, explain it in one line, give a tiny example with expected output, and describe one case where it may break.
prompts.verify: Sample row पर formula चलाकर expected output मिलाइए।

prompts.title: Automation mapper
prompts.purpose: क्या automate करना सुरक्षित है, तय करना।
prompts.body: My repeated process: [steps]. Identify which steps can be automated safely, which need human review, and which should not be automated because of privacy, platform rules or client risk. Suggest the simplest no-code design, and note any step that could break a platform's terms.
prompts.example: Contact form से Sheet में entry।
prompts.verify: Test data से चलाइए, real client data से नहीं।

prompts.title: 7-day skill sprint
prompts.purpose: Service के लिए ज़रूरी गैप भरना।
prompts.body: I need to reach a usable level in [sub-skill] for [deliverable] within 7 days, at [hours] a day. Build a daily plan where each day produces a small visible output. Recommend only what to practise, and tell me how to judge the output. Tell me to find current tutorials on official documentation instead of inventing links.
prompts.verify: Day 7 output को किसी practitioner से review कराइए।

prompts.title: Risk review
prompts.purpose: भेजने से पहले legal और ethical flags।
prompts.body: Review this content or plan for risks: false claims, unauthorised use of someone's name or logo, privacy issues, spam-like tactics, and guaranteed results. List each risk, why it matters and a safer rewrite. This is not legal advice; mark anything that needs a professional. Content: [paste]
prompts.verify: Serious items पर professional से पूछिए।

prompts.title: Weekly review coach
prompts.purpose: अपने data से अगले हफ़्ते का plan।
prompts.body: This week's numbers: messages sent [n], replies [n], calls [n], proposals [n], won [n], hours worked [n]. Notes: [notes]. Identify the weakest stage of my funnel, suggest 2 small experiments for next week, and tell me what you cannot conclude from such a small sample.
prompts.verify: एक हफ़्ते में एक ही बदलाव test कीजिए।

prompts.title: Offer stress test
prompts.purpose: Offer में छिपे confusing हिस्से ढूँढना।
prompts.body: Here is my service offer: [offer]. Read it as a busy [buyer]. List: 5 questions you still have, 3 phrases that sound vague, the first objection you would raise, and one change that would make it easier to say yes. Do not suggest any promise I cannot control.
prompts.output: Questions, vague phrases, objection, one change.
prompts.verify: एक असली buyer से भी यही पूछिए।

prompts.title: Hours estimator
prompts.purpose: Project को tasks में बाँटकर hours निकालना।
prompts.body: Break down delivering [deliverable] into tasks. For each task give best-case, likely and worst-case hours for someone at [skill level]. Include client communication, revisions, testing and file handover. Total them, and note which estimates are most uncertain.
prompts.verify: पहले project के असली hours से compare कीजिए और अपनी estimate sheet update कीजिए।

prompts.title: Evidence sheet design
prompts.purpose: Research के लिए simple tracking format बनाना।
prompts.body: Design a one-sheet research tracker for validating [service] for [buyer] in [market]. Include columns for source, date, exact quote, signal type and confidence. Add 5 rules for avoiding confirmation bias. Do not include market figures.
prompts.verify: एक real source से एक row भरकर देखिए कि format काम करता है।

prompts.title: Fictional client brief
prompts.purpose: Demo project के लिए realistic brief।
prompts.body: Create a realistic fictional client brief for a demo project in [service] for a [buyer] in [city type]. Include business background, target customer, problem, goals, constraints, must-have elements and a success checklist. Label it clearly as fictional and use a name that is unlikely to belong to a real business, and tell me to search the name before using it.
prompts.verify: Name को Google और Maps पर खोजिए।

prompts.title: Price sanity check
prompts.body: Here is my quote calculation: [hours, rate, costs, buffer, price]. Check the arithmetic, list hidden costs I may have missed, list scope items likely to expand, and suggest two ways to reduce scope instead of reducing price. Do not suggest market rates unless you can give a source.
prompts.output: Arithmetic check, hidden costs, scope options.
prompts.verify: Calculation Bonus C की sheet पर खुद चलाइए।

prompts.title: CA question list
prompts.purpose: CA से मिलने से पहले सही सवाल।
prompts.body: I run [service] as a [structure] in [state], India, with expected annual receipts of [range], clients in [locations]. Write a list of 15 questions to ask my CA about GST, income tax, invoices, foreign receipts and records. Do not answer them or state any rule as definite. Group by topic.
prompts.verify: CA के जवाब लिखकर अपनी compliance sheet में रखिए।

prompts.title: Lead magnet planner
prompts.purpose: Useful और genuine free resource बनाना।
prompts.body: Suggest 5 one-page lead magnet ideas for [buyer] that help with [problem] without needing my paid service. For each give the title, what it contains, the action the reader can take in 15 minutes and what would make it low quality. Avoid exaggerated promises.
prompts.verify: 2 buyers से पूछिए कि कौन सा वे सच में use करेंगे।

prompts.title: Message critic
prompts.purpose: भेजने से पहले message की कमज़ोरी पकड़ना।
prompts.body: Critique this outreach message as a busy [buyer]. Score 1-5 on specificity, relevance, honesty, and ease of reply. Point out anything that sounds automated, pushy or unverifiable. Rewrite it in under 80 words without inventing facts. Message: [paste]
prompts.verify: Rewritten message में सभी facts सच हैं, यह जाँचिए।

prompts.title: Handover guide
prompts.purpose: Client के लिए simple handover document।
prompts.body: Write a one-page handover guide for a non-technical owner of [deliverable]. Include what they received, how to perform the 3 most common tasks, what not to change, who to contact and what happens if a subscription expires. Use only the details below and flag anything missing. Details: [details]
prompts.verify: Guide से खुद तीनों tasks करके देखिए।

prompts.title: 30-day retrospective
prompts.purpose: 30 days के data से अगला plan बनाना।
prompts.body: Here is my 30-day data: [tracker summary]. Service: [service]. Buyer: [buyer]. Identify what I can and cannot conclude from this sample, the weakest stage, the 3 most useful experiments for the next 30 days and what I should stop doing. Don't be falsely encouraging and don't predict income.
prompts.verify: अपने raw numbers से conclusions जाँचिए।

prompts.title: Problem-first idea scan
prompts.purpose: Skill से नहीं, problems से ideas निकालना।
prompts.body: List 15 recurring operational problems faced by [business type] in [location] that a solo service provider could help with. For each, state who feels it, how it is handled today, and the likely evidence I could check. Do not cite figures you cannot source.
prompts.verify: Top 5 को Maps reviews या interviews से जाँचिए।

prompts.title: Adjacent services map
prompts.purpose: मौजूदा skill के पास की services देखना।
prompts.body: My current skill is [skill]. Map 8 adjacent services I could learn within [weeks], and rate each for skill overlap, likely buyer, startup cost and delivery risk. Explain your rating in one line each.
prompts.verify: हर service के 3 real providers ढूँढिए।

prompts.title: Micro-niche generator
prompts.purpose: एक broad service को सटीक niches में बाँटना।
prompts.body: Break down [service] into 12 narrow niches by industry, business stage and urgent problem. For each, give a one-line positioning and how I could find 20 potential buyers manually.
prompts.verify: 20 नाम सच में मिलते हैं? न मिलें तो niche छोड़िए।

prompts.title: Constraint-based ideas
prompts.purpose: आपकी सीमाओं के अंदर ideas ढूँढना।
prompts.body: My constraints are: [hours/day], [budget], [device], [language], [no client calls or other limits]. Suggest 6 service ideas that fit these constraints, and clearly explain which common ideas I should avoid and why.
prompts.verify: Weekly schedule में एक project रखकर देखिए।

prompts.title: Past experience miner
prompts.purpose: पुराने अनुभव से छिपी service ढूँढना।
prompts.body: Interview me one question at a time about my education, jobs, hobbies, tools and problems I have solved for others. After 8 questions, list 5 service ideas based only on my answers, and note the proof I already have for each.
prompts.verify: Proof असली है या नहीं, खुद जाँचिए।

prompts.title: Idea kill test
prompts.purpose: जल्दी पता चले कि idea कहाँ कमज़ोर है।
prompts.body: For this idea: [idea], write 10 yes/no questions that could kill it. Sort by which is the cheapest to answer first. Next to each, write the exact action I can take this week to answer it.
prompts.verify: पहले 3 का जवाब 7 दिनों में लीजिए।

prompts.title: Local versus online choice
prompts.purpose: Local या online market में से चुनना।
prompts.body: Compare selling [service] to local businesses in [city] against online clients in [country]. Consider trust-building, competition, payment, compliance, communication and time to first conversation. Give a recommendation for a beginner with [situation] and state what would change it.
prompts.verify: दोनों markets के 5-5 buyers से बात कीजिए।

prompts.title: Skill-gap plan
prompts.purpose: Service शुरू करने से पहले gap पहचानना।
prompts.body: To deliver [service] to a professional standard, list the minimum skills needed. I rate myself as: [ratings]. Identify the gaps that would actually harm a client and the gaps that can wait, and give a small practice task for each critical gap.
prompts.verify: Practice output को किसी experienced व्यक्ति को दिखाइए।

prompts.title: Recurring revenue angle
prompts.purpose: One-time service में repeat मौका ढूँढना।
prompts.body: My one-time service is [service] for [buyer]. Suggest 5 natural recurring services that follow it, with what triggers the need and what a small monthly scope could look like. Exclude anything that would not create real value.
prompts.verify: Discovery calls में पूछिए कि क्या यह ज़रूरत सच में होती है।

prompts.title: Business statement polisher
prompts.body: Rewrite this business statement in 5 different ways under 20 words each: [statement]. Keep it specific about who, outcome and service. Avoid hype. Then pick the clearest one for a non-technical business owner and explain why.
prompts.verify: किसी अनजान व्यक्ति से पूछिए कि क्या समझ आया।

prompts.title: Search query planner
prompts.purpose: Research के लिए सही search terms बनाना।
prompts.body: Create 25 Google search queries a [buyer] might use when facing [problem], in English and Hinglish. Group them by awareness stage: noticing the problem, exploring solutions, comparing providers. Mark them as guesses to test, not as search volume data.
prompts.verify: हर query को Google में चलाकर देखिए।

prompts.title: Review mining
prompts.body: Below are public reviews that I manually copied, with names removed: [reviews]. Extract recurring complaints, praise, unmet needs and exact phrases. Count how often each theme appears. Do not invent any theme not present in the text.
prompts.verify: Counts को एक बार manually match कीजिए।

prompts.title: Trends interpretation
prompts.purpose: Trends के data को ठीक से पढ़ना।
prompts.body: I checked Google Trends for [terms] in [region] for [period] and saw: [describe]. Explain what this can and cannot tell me, since the data is relative and normalised, and what follow-up checks I should do before deciding.
prompts.verify: Google की Trends FAQ से interpretation मिलाइए।

prompts.title: Community question finder
prompts.purpose: Communities में क्या खोजें, तय करना।
prompts.body: Which kinds of online communities might [buyer] use to discuss [problem]? Give search phrases I can use to find them, what to read for, and rules for researching ethically without spamming. Tell me to confirm that each community actually exists.
prompts.verify: हर community खोलकर उसके rules पढ़िए।

prompts.title: Interview invitation variants
prompts.body: Write 4 short interview requests for [buyer] about [problem]: for a warm contact, a referral, a LinkedIn connection and an in-person ask. State clearly that I am not selling, ask for 15 minutes, and make it easy to say no.
prompts.verify: भेजते समय कुछ भी बिकाऊ न लगे, देख लीजिए।

prompts.title: Validation decision memo
prompts.body: Evidence: [interviews, competitor notes, signals]. Write a one-page Go, Refine or Drop memo. Separate facts from my interpretation, list what evidence is missing, and describe the next single test. Do not be optimistic beyond the evidence.
prompts.verify: Facts को original notes से मिलाइए।

prompts.title: Evidence-based persona
prompts.body: Using only these interview notes: [notes], draft a customer persona with role, context, problem, trigger, current solution, budget signals, objections and channels. Mark each line as Observed, Inferred or Unknown.
prompts.verify: Unknown lines अगली interview में पूछिए।

prompts.title: Jobs to be done
prompts.body: For [buyer] hiring help with [area], write jobs-to-be-done statements in this format: When [situation], I want to [motivation], so I can [outcome]. Give 8, and mark them as hypotheses to be tested.
prompts.verify: Interviews में सही और गलत पहचानिए।

prompts.title: Buying committee map
prompts.body: In a [business size and type], who might influence a decision to buy [service]? Map the user, decider, payer and blocker, with what each cares about and one question to ask each. Mark it as a hypothesis.
prompts.verify: Call में पूछिए: "Decision कैसे होता है?"

prompts.title: Language bank
prompts.purpose: Buyer की अपनी भाषा जमा करना।
prompts.body: Convert these buyer quotes into a language bank with columns: exact words, underlying problem, where to use (headline, email, proposal). Do not reword the quotes. Quotes: [quotes]
prompts.verify: Publish करते समय personal details मत दीजिए।

prompts.title: Website teardown
prompts.body: From this public page text of a competitor: [text], identify the target buyer, main promise, proof, offer structure, CTA and what is vague. Suggest how I might position differently without copying their words or making false comparisons.
prompts.verify: अपनी claims सच रखिए; competitor की बुराई मत कीजिए।

prompts.title: Comparison table setup
prompts.purpose: Competitors को एक ढाँचे में रखना।
prompts.body: Create a comparison template for [service] providers with 10 relevant criteria. For each, explain what a good answer looks like and where public evidence is usually found. Add a "not public" option so I don't guess.
prompts.verify: एक competitor भरकर template test कीजिए।

prompts.title: Differentiation brainstorm
prompts.body: Competitors offer: [summary]. My real strengths: [strengths]. Suggest 8 ways to differentiate based on niche, process, communication, speed, language or guarantee of scope. Reject any idea that requires a claim I can't prove.
prompts.verify: Buyers से पूछिए कि उन्हें इनमें से क्या मायने रखता है।

prompts.title: Price signal reader
prompts.body: These are prices I found, with sources and dates: [list]. Organise them by scope, explain why they may not be comparable and what questions I should answer before setting my own. Do not infer an average market rate from this small sample.
prompts.verify: Sources और dates फिर देखिए।

prompts.title: Deliverable clarifier
